PluginData.Author: RougeSable
PluginData.Tooltip: In-game map on M: the real planet globe, your neighbourhood in space, the solar system and the galaxy of servers, with a memory of what you have seen.
PluginData.Description: Sir Holomap adds a full screen map to Space Engineers, opened and closed with M (when a block is in hand, M keeps the game's symmetry). Planet: the planet you are on, drawn by the game's own renderer from orbit, with you, your grids and the bases in place; the mouse wheel zooms down to the ground. Local space: your neighbourhood in space, seen from above a virtual plane, every grid linked to the plane by its altitude line, the planets hiding the plane behind them; double click a grid to fly the camera around it. System: the whole system, planets and moons laid flat, the system in 3D with true distances, and the galaxy where every server you know has a fixed place. The map remembers everything that entered your synchronisation range: live markers are sharp, memories are greyed with the time you saw them. The memory stays on your machine, one per server. A double click on a server of the galaxy joins it after a confirmation that names it, with a box for its password when it asks for one. The map speaks the language set in the game. Nothing goes through the server, and nothing on the map moves your character.
